WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(total) AS total FROM customer_totals
),
customer_shares AS (
  SELECT ct.CustomerId, ct.total, 1.0 * ct.total / gt.total AS share
  FROM customer_totals AS ct
  CROSS JOIN grand_total AS gt
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM customer_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT cs.total, cs.share, (cs.share - aa.avg_share) / aa.avg_share AS relative_excess
  FROM customer_shares AS cs
  CROSS JOIN average_share AS aa
  WHERE cs.share > aa.avg_share
)
SELECT AVG(total), AVG(share), AVG(relative_excess)
FROM above_average
